items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I'll tell you about Jack Leg's Diamonds... I used to play down -- I had a group down

ctx.x: And 7th Avenue. It was near what theatre.

Right near the Lafayette Theatre. It was a college inn I think then and then they -- what was the name of the brothers, George and -- they bought the thing and turned it over -- I used to arrange music in there. Yeah. I've arranged music all over the -- I'll tell you about Jack Leg's Diamonds.
